offering_description.value: Builds site development, e-infrastructure, transportation and building projects for public agencies and private developers such as data center, warehouse and residential builders. It uses its own crews and equipment and produces aggregates and asphalt for its projects.

primary_products.value: aggregates; hot-mix asphalt; precast concrete; ready-mixed concrete

primary_services.value: site development excavation and grading; highway, road and bridge construction; heavy civil construction; residential foundations and concrete; water and sewer infrastructure

customer_segment.value: B2G: state departments of transportation, municipalities, and other public agencies; B2B: data center, warehouse, e-commerce and commercial developers, homebuilders

end_markets.value: data centers; transportation and highways; commercial and warehouse development; residential construction; water infrastructure

revenue_model.value: project or contract: fixed-price, unit-price and cost-plus construction contracts; product sales: aggregates and asphalt sold to third parties

value_chain_position.value: service provider: construction contractor using own crews, equipment and materials for public and private owners; OEM / manufacturer: produces aggregates, asphalt and concrete from owned quarries and plants

geography_served.value: US regional: Texas, Utah, Nevada, Arizona, California, Colorado, Hawaii, Minnesota, South Carolina and other select states

specialization.value: related lines: e-infrastructure, transportation and building solutions construction, plus aggregates and asphalt materials

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: competitive bidding and negotiated contracts with public agencies and private developers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: public contracting rules, prevailing wage, DOT standards, environmental, OSHA safety and mining regulations
